freedom writers.bio: Freedom Writers are a Toronto hip hop collective made up of five established solo MCs: Theo 3, Tona, Adam Bomb, Frankie Payne and Progress, with Big Sproxx handling production. The group came together through a shared interest in socially and politically conscious lyricism, with each member setting aside solo work to build something collectively. Following the pre-release project "Soon", their debut album, "Now", arrived on October 10, 2013. The 17-track record was produced by Sproxx and featured appearances from Ian Kamau and Ayah. "Now" earned a place on the 2014 Polaris Music Prize long list. A second album, "Again", followed in 2017. Freedom Writers' music joined Northern Dial's library in November 2026.

angerville.bio: Angerville are a hip hop duo from Aurora, Ontario, made up of MCs Conscious Thought and Fortunato. The group formed in 1998 as a trio with Ill da Shystee (Luke Marson), travelling across Ontario for freestyle battles and open mics. Marson was murdered in 2002 at 22, and the remaining two carried the name forward. Based in Aurora, where they ran Angerville Entertainment, the duo built a deep catalogue of hardcore, traditional hip hop: "Rebellion" and the Royce Birth collaboration "Blood, Sweat & Tears" in 2008, "Uprising" in 2010 and "Warfare" in 2011. Angerville's music joined Northern Dial's library in November 2026.

devon tracy.bio: Devon Tracy is a rapper and dancer from Mississauga, Ontario, who began releasing music as a teenager. His debut single, "Green Goblin", arrived in September 2010, and his freestyle over Pac Div's "Anti-Freeze" built an early buzz the following year. His "Dream Chase" mixtape followed in December 2011, with production from Jazz Feezy, Boi-1da's camp and others, and he kept working on both sides of the border, later basing himself in Atlanta for a stretch. In 2018 he released "Choosin", a collaboration with Atlanta's Gunna tied to his "4AM" project. Northern Dial's library carries "Choosin (feat. Gunna)", "Turn You Up", "Ambition" and "Crew Love", which joined the library in November 2026.

4th pyramid.bio: 4th Pyramid is the stage name of Adam Farag, a Toronto rapper, producer, songwriter and DJ of Egyptian descent. He first made noise as a beatmaker, signing with New York's Definitive Jux label and appearing on "Definitive Jux Presents III". As a producer and engineer he has credits with the Black Eyed Peas, Pete Rock, MF Doom and members of Wu-Tang Clan. His debut solo rap album, "The Pyramid Scheme", arrived in 2012 on his own Silk Ivory imprint through Universal Music Canada, followed by "The Sky Belongs to the Stars" EP in 2013. He also tours as Jazz Cartier's official DJ. His track "Let The Drummer Play" joined Northern Dial's library in November 2026.
album_titles: The Sky Belongs to the Stars

perfeck strangers.bio: Perfeck Strangers are a Toronto hip hop duo made up of veteran solo MCs Dan-e-o and Promise. Dan-e-o had been a fixture of the city's underground since the 1990s, with solo albums including "The Book of Daniel" and "See No Evil, Hear No Evil", while Promise built his name on conscious, soul-leaning records like "More Than Music" and "Awakening". Their first single as a duo, "Work To Do", leaked in the summer of 2010 with an appearance from Drake, and their debut album, "Series Premiere", was released in March 2012 through URBNET Records. "Work To Do" featuring Drake joined Northern Dial's library in November 2026.
album_titles: See No Evil, Hear No Evil

phat tony.bio: Phat Tony, also known as Big Tweeze, is a Toronto hip hop producer and member of the production crew F.A.T. Thursday. He is best known for his run of work with MC Theo3. His summery single "Turnaroundagain", featuring Theo3 and Ski over his own production, picked up play on DJ Eclipse's New York radio show in 2010, and in January 2011 the pair released "The 2 Week EP", written and recorded in two weeks to raise money for a Toronto youth program. A second edition followed in 2012, and he also produced Adversaree's "Tongues Uv Machetes 2" EP. "Turnaroundagain" featuring Theo3 and Ski joined Northern Dial's library in November 2026.

pikihed.bio: Pikihed is a Toronto hip hop artist from Regent Park, best known as a member of Point Blank, the long-running crew formed in that neighbourhood in the early 1990s. The group's own bio lists six MCs and an in-house producer: Imperial, Trouble, Stump, Kidd, RPD, Jackal and Pikihed, all raised in Regent Park and recording for their own Tilt Rock Records. Pikihed, an identical twin alongside his brother RPD, has also worked behind the boards, earning a production credit on Theo3's "Elevator Up" mixtape. His track "Under The Sun", featuring Theo3, joined Northern Dial's library in November 2026.

the sars network.bio: The SARS Network is a Toronto hip hop collective and label circle that grew out of the city's Empire crew and the S.A.R.S. mixtape series, which took its name from the phrase "Sick Artists Runnin' Shit" and showcased the city's battle-tested MCs. The circle's core names include Talksick, Adam Bomb, T.R.A. (Tha Rhyme Animal), Tekman, Caution Da Don, Puzzle, Episode Ace Holla and William Blankz, releasing music through the network's own Bandcamp. In January 2013 the crew released "The SARS Cypher #2", mixed by DJ Law, with verses in order from Talksick, Caution Da Don, William Blankz, Tekman, T.R.A. and Episode Ace Holla. That cypher joined Northern Dial's library in November 2026.

theo3.bio: Theo3, also known as Theology 3, is a Toronto MC and member of the Freedom Writers collective. A punchline-heavy lyricist who has been part of the city's underground since the 2000s, he is credited with coining the nickname "Screwface Capital" for Toronto. His "Elevator Up" mixtape, hosted by DJ Tony Touch, collected his work in 2012, and his debut album, "Airplane Over One Way Streets", arrived in December 2013 with production from Tone Mason, SCAM and Phat Tony. Alongside the music he has run youth programs in Toronto for years. Northern Dial's library carries his tracks "Ari Gold" and "TIME", plus many features, which joined the library in November 2026.

sese.bio: Sese, who has recorded as Sayzee since 2017, is a Toronto MC known for relentless, horror-tinged battle rap. He launched his "YFRWN" series, short for Your Favorite Rapper's Worst Nightmare and themed after Freddy Krueger, in October 2010. The first volume carried two of his best-known early records, "It Ain't Safe", with JRDN, Magnum 357 and Mayhem Morearty, and "POW!", with Luu Breeze, both produced by 2oolman. He followed it with the album "Age of Aquarius" in 2013, and the YFRWN series has kept running, reaching its eleventh volume in 2026. Northern Dial's library carries "It Ain't Safe", "Pow!" and "Progress", his collaboration with Kayo, which joined the library in November 2026.

kayo.bio: Kayo, who records as Kayo Guevarra, is a rapper and singer born and raised in St. Lucia and based in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Born Filbert Salton, he moved to Canada to study commerce at Saint Mary's University, signed with EMI Music Canada and opened a national tour for Snoop Dogg. His sound, which he calls "future meets Fugees", blends hip hop with R&B, reggae and dancehall from his island upbringing. His catalogue includes "Winter In St. Lucia" in 2018 and the collaborative "KNOWHERE" EP in 2020. Northern Dial's library carries "Progress", his 2012 collaboration with Sese, which joined the library in November 2026.
